title: GET /api/decks/share/:token/walkthrough (D5791, #5791)
description: The walkthrough attached to one investor share link, as the share viewer plays it (`routes/deck_share_walkthrough.ts`, `services/decks/recordings.ts` sharedWalkthroughOf). `attached` is false, with no takes, when nothing is attached to this link. Each take is the maker's newest of a card the link sends, in card order, named by the card's uid; it carries nothing of the member (no caption model, charge, size or date). Captions that were not recorded are null, never an empty list. Not an adapter method: the share viewer calls its own client (`frontend/src/lib/api/deckShareWalkthrough.js`), as the other share reads do, so this schema is checked by `deck_share_walkthrough_d5791.test.ts`, not listed in `CONTRACTS`.
